_comment: Gateway config used by the Render deploy (jarvis-2). Pointed at via OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH in render.yaml. It enables the /v1/responses API (off by default), persists the agent workspace on the mounted /data disk, and uses password auth consistently so the control panel login and the live console share one credential (OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PASSWORD). Secrets come from the Render environment, never from this file.

gateway._auth_comment: Password mode: OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PASSWORD is BOTH the control-panel login and the Bearer credential for /v1/responses. (The gateway selects password mode whenever a password is set, so a separate token would be ignored.)

endpoints._comment: Both default to DISABLED. The live web console calls /v1/responses, so it must be enabled here.

defaults._workspace_comment: On the mounted disk so persona edits, notes, and memory survive every redeploy.

heartbeat.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md if it exists (workspace context). Follow it strictly. If nothing needs attention, reply HEARTBEAT_OK.

load._comment: The repo is checked out at /app in the container; the JARVIS skills live here.

telegram._comment: Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in the Render environment to chat with JARVIS. Locked to you.

tts._comment: Premium British butler voice. Set ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in the Render environment. Leave unset to fall back to the free 'edge' voice.
